press.plainEnglish: A first-person look starts when the player asks. The interact action traces from the camera, and a hit calls Interact. Fire is the same shape for a shot. The mapping context owns the key, so the graph never reads a key code.
press.whyGame: Tracing every frame spends a query while the player stands still, and reading the key code breaks the moment they rebind.

expansions.title: Use
expansions.detail: IA_Interact fires Triggered, then the trace, then the interface.

expansions.title: Fire
expansions.detail: IA_Fire is the same shape for a shot.

expansions.title: Rebind
expansions.detail: Move the binding in the context. Leave the graph alone.

quiz.prompt: The player presses the use key in a first-person kit. What starts?
choices: IA_Interact, then a trace from the camera
A query on every idle frame

quiz.prompt: The interact function runs because Triggered fired. What did the player just do?
choices: Took a hit from another player
quiz.why: That function is the use action.

quiz.prompt: The use trace hits a door. What call runs on the door?
choices: A cast that names the door class

quiz.prompt: You move the use trace onto the frame loop so the prompt never feels late. What keeps getting paid for?
choices: A physics query while nobody is pressing use
quiz.why: The press already asks at the right time.

quiz.prompt: Fire should trace the shot. Which action is that, in the same shape as use?
choices: The use action, reused for the bullet
The overlap that picks up ammo
quiz.why: A shot is its own press.

quiz.prompt: The mapping context owns the key or pad binding, so the interact graph never reads a raw key code.
quiz.why: The mapping context owns the device.

quiz.prompt: A player moves use from a keyboard key to a pad face button. What changes in the trace?
choices: Nothing. The action still fires Triggered
The trace origin moves to the chest
The door must register the new button
quiz.why: Rebind the context, not the graph.

quiz.prompt: Where does the first-person use trace begin?
choices: At the camera, along the aim

quiz.prompt: The hit bool is false. What should the use graph do?
choices: Call Interact on the nearest actor
quiz.why: A miss is not a use.

quiz.prompt: Which line is the first-person press, not a timer?
choices: The interact function that runs when the action fires
A hunter look on a fifth-of-a-second loop
A vision pass four times a second
A route step once a second

assignment.plainPrompt: Why does a first-person look start when the player presses use or fire, not on the frame?
assignment.whyGamePrompt: What query runs while the player stands still, and what breaks on rebind, if the graph reads the key code?

magazine.plainEnglish: Reload is its own button. The magazine is in the gun, reserve is on the body, and mag size is the cap. Both checks have to pass before the clamp moves rounds into the gap.
magazine.whyGame: Reloading from the frame loop fills the gun while the player is only looking, or while they are doing nothing.

expansions.title: The gap
expansions.detail: Clamp writes how many rounds fit, and no more.

expansions.title: An empty body
expansions.detail: Reserve at zero fails the greater-than check.

expansions.title: A full gun
expansions.detail: A magazine at mag size fails the less-than check.

quiz.prompt: Which action is allowed to move rounds from the body into the gun?
The reload excerpt clamps reserve into the space left in the gun. What does that result count?
choices: Rounds that will move on this reload
How many items are in the backpack

quiz.prompt: The magazine is below its cap and the body still has a round. What runs next?
choices: A line trace from the camera

quiz.prompt: The frame loop adds the clamped amount every frame. What happens while the player is only aiming?
choices: No change, if aiming blocked the frame loop

quiz.prompt: The gun holds 30 of 30 and the body has rounds. Which check refuses the reload?
choices: Greater than zero on the body
quiz.why: A full magazine does not take more.

quiz.prompt: Fire starts the shot, and a separate reload action is what moves rounds into the magazine.
The body has zero rounds and the gun is half empty. Which check fails?
choices: The reserve still has a round
The magazine is below its cap

quiz.prompt: Which three numbers describe this reload?
choices: Rounds in the gun, rounds on the body, and the cap
A life total, a gait, and whether the sights are up
Stack count, route direction, and heat
The key code, the pad code, and the widget font

quiz.prompt: The clamp runs and reserve is not reduced. What does the next reload still see?
choices: Those same rounds on the body
quiz.why: The transfer has to leave the body.

quiz.prompt: The gun holds 20 of 30 and the body holds 4. How many rounds move?
choices: 4, because the body cannot give the full gap
The whole ten-round gap, even though the body is short
A fresh thirty-round gun, as if this one were replaced
No transfer, if looking down the sights were the reload
quiz.why: The clamp takes the smaller of the gap and the reserve.

assignment.plainPrompt: Why is reload its own button, and only after both the magazine and the reserve have room to move?
assignment.whyGamePrompt: What fills the gun while the player is only looking if reload runs from the frame loop?

pickup.plainEnglish: Overlap is the pickup. If the stack still has room, the true pin calls AddToSlot, so a rifle and a medkit share one call. The trace that highlights a door does not increment a stack.
pickup.whyGame: A cast to one pickup class drops the other on the floor forever, and a use-trace that adds items picks them up by looking.

expansions.title: A rifle
expansions.detail: It implements the slot add. The overlap does not cast to the rifle.

expansions.title: The highlight
expansions.detail: The interact trace can show a prompt. It does not add.

quiz.prompt: A rifle touches the capsule. Which event adds it?
choices: The press that highlights a door
quiz.why: Touching the capsule is the pickup.

quiz.prompt: The overlap sees a stack that still has room and calls the slot function. What does the call accomplish?
choices: It asks the inventory to take the item
It opens the door under the crosshair
It moves rounds inside the gun

quiz.prompt: The stack still has room. What runs on the true pin?
Looking at a medkit puts it in the inventory. What did the use trace do that belongs to overlap?
quiz.why: Use can show a prompt. Overlap picks up.

quiz.prompt: A rifle and a medkit need to enter the same inventory. Which call do both answer?
choices: A cast to the rifle class only
quiz.why: One call. The item differs in data.

quiz.prompt: A cast to the rifle class is enough for every pickup.
quiz.why: The medkit never matches that cast.

quiz.prompt: The stack is already full. What should another overlap do?
choices: Grow the stack past the item data

quiz.prompt: Where does the stack size live?
choices: As a literal in the use graph
quiz.why: The component reads a decision the data already made.

quiz.prompt: The overlap runs and the stack count is zero. What happens?
Which graph highlights a door without changing a stack?
quiz.why: Highlight and pickup are different events.

assignment.plainPrompt: Why is overlap the pickup, with one AddToSlot call shared by a rifle and a medkit?
assignment.whyGamePrompt: What stays on the floor forever, and what is collected by looking, if you cast to one class or add items from the use trace?

authority.plainEnglish: Damage is an event. The server writes health inside the authority check. Other machines learn the float from OnRep and play the hit. They do not subtract again. The widget reads the float. It is not what you replicate.
authority.whyGame: A second subtract on the notify bites twice, and replicating the widget ships fonts and layout.

expansions.title: The write
expansions.detail: The generated health function nests the assignment inside the owner authority check.

expansions.title: The flash
expansions.detail: OnRep plays it. The number is already final.

expansions.title: The bar
expansions.detail: Read the float. Do not replicate the widget.

quiz.prompt: A first-person hit should change health. Where does that write sit?
choices: Inside HasAuthority, from the damage event
On the owning client, beside the hit flash
Beside the reaction in the notify

quiz.prompt: The health function nests the assignment inside the owner authority check. What does that nesting prevent?
choices: A client write that the server will snap back

quiz.prompt: The server has written the new health. What should the other machines play?
choices: The hit reaction, from the notify
Another subtract of the same hit

quiz.prompt: OnRep both flashes and subtracts. What does the shot land as?
You replicate the health widget so the bar matches. What extra payload moves?
quiz.why: Replicate the float. Let the bar read it.

quiz.prompt: The hit notify should subtract health again.
A widget reads health. What should it not do?
choices: Hide when the pawn is dead
Sit on the owning player's screen
quiz.why: The float is the fact. The bar is a view.

quiz.prompt: A client subtracts health so the flash feels instant. What snaps?
choices: The number, back to whatever the server still has
How many rounds the gun holds
quiz.why: The client number was never authority.

quiz.prompt: Which line is the first-person health write?
choices: The assignment nested in the owner authority check
A subtract inside the hit notify
A paint of the health bar
A clamp of reserve into the magazine

quiz.prompt: Damage, the authority write, and the notify are three steps. Which order matches them?
choices: The hit event, then the server assignment, then the reaction
The reaction, then a client subtract, then a widget replicate
A frame subtract, then a flash, then a save
A highlight, then a transfer of rounds, then a pickup

assignment.plainPrompt: Why does damage write health on the server, while other machines only play the hit from OnRep?
assignment.whyGamePrompt: What bites twice, and what heavy payload ships, if the notify subtracts again or the widget itself is replicated?
